protocol.scope: Exploratory astronomy/date-conditioned number frequencies, not validation of any astrology tradition or causal mechanism
protocol.timeConvention: 20:00 Europe/Rome for every historical date; nominal proxy, actual historical draw instants not verified
protocol.aspectDefinition: Geocentric longitude separation folded to 0..180 degrees. Bins: within 6 degrees of 0, 90, 120, 180; otherwise fifth bin. Some bins may be empty due to physical geometry; no thresholds retuned.
protocol.scoring: For each feature and current bin: (number occurrences in that bin + 30 * unconditional trailing-208 frequency) / (draws in bin + 30). Average over features of a model. Maximum 3 numbers per decade.
protocol.multiplicity: Holm across ten upper-tail comparisons: five exact uniform-null and five circular-feature-shift tests. Historical searches before this experiment remain uncorrected.
protocol.prospectivePolicy: No model selected automatically from historical best score. No modifications to existing forward tests. A future astronomy protocol requires explicit separate selection before its first draw.

randomArchives.description: Independent uniform 6/90 archives: hit totals versus a fixed six-number ticket, equivalent marginal null for any no-lookahead predictor; not a full strategy refit.

validation.independentChecker: PowerShell implementation separate from JavaScript scoring helper
validation.limits: Independent predictor checks are a one-date sample, not a second full historical replay; astronomical coordinates rely on the pinned library, not independent ephemeris verification.

limitations: Historical data already explored: all p-values exploratory.
Circular shifts preserve much temporal dependence but introduce wrap-around; diagnostic only, not a causal test.
Sun and slow planets proxy season/date and are not isolated causal effects.
Nominal historical draw hour is a proxy; shifts are sensitivity controls, not validation of actual times.
Five numerical definitions do not cover every astrology system. No fixed-star or birth-chart test.
No monetary advantage measured. No model selected or prospective ticket changed.
